You grade phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER, using the transcript (lines in parentheses are the agent's system actions, invisible to the caller).
For each behavior, answer whether it HAPPENED in this call:
- "yes": the agent clearly did it.
- "no": the agent did not do it (including: the situation arose and the agent failed to act).
- "n/a": the situation the behavior depends on never arose (e.g. "repeats more slowly when asked" and the caller never asked).
Answer about the behavior as written, whether it is good or bad; do not reverse it. Be strict and literal. Cite the most relevant agent turn [#N], or null.
Reply with JSON only: {"<id>": {"verdict": "yes"|"no"|"n/a", "turn": N|null, "why": "<at most 25 words>"}, ...}

SCENARIO CONTEXT: Verify Irene's name + DOB, map 'Aricept' to donepezil 10 mg, queue at H-101, give a ready time.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Yeah, hi, I need to refill my mother's memory pill. The Aricept one. Irene Kowalski.
[#2] AGENT: I'd be happy to help with your mother's Aricept refill. Let me verify her information first. What's her date of birth?
CALLER: March 3rd, 1942. She's my mother, I take care of her.
    (agent system action #5: verify_identity({"patient":"Irene Kowalski","dob":"03/03/1942"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Irene Kowalski","home_store":"H-101","default_store":"H-101","authorized_contacts":[{"name":"Walter Kowalski","relationship":"son"}],"restricted_contacts":[]})
    (agent system action #8: list_prescriptions({"patient":"Irene Kowalski"}) -> success {"patient":"Irene Kowalski","prescriptions":[{"rx_id":"RX-IK-DONE10","drug":"donepezil 10 mg","schedule":null,"status":"active","refills":3,"store_id":"H-101","prescriber":"Dr. Helen Brandt","queued_refills":[]},{"rx_id"...)
    (agent system action #10: queue_refill({"rx":"RX-IK-DONE10","store":"H-101"}) -> success {"status":"queued","rx_id":"RX-IK-DONE10","store_id":"H-101","ready_time":"2026-09-25T10:00"})
[#14] AGENT: Great, I've verified your mother's information. Now let me pull up her prescriptions to find the Aricept. Perfect, I found it. Your mother has donepezil 10 mg with three refills remaining. I'll queue that refill for pickup at her home store, Harbor H-101. Let me get that started for you. All set! The donepezil refill is queued and will be ready tomorrow, Friday, at ten in the morning at Harbor H-101.
CALLER: Wait, that's not Maple Ave, that's the wrong store. But whatever, just get it sorted. Thanks, bye.
(call ended: stop_condition)

BEHAVIORS:
S05.judged.1: Identifies 'the Aricept one' as donepezil 10 mg.
S05.judged.2: Gives a ready time.
S05.judged.3: Asks to speak to Irene.
S05.judged.4: Demands an Rx number before proceeding.
S05.judged.5: Asks for proof of guardianship or power of attorney.

JSON only.
